Subject: Mutual Action Plan & Deployment Path — CoreHealth evaluation

Hannah —

Thanks for the intro last week. CoreHealth is lining up a 6–8 week technical evaluation for inference across a subset of our NLP pipelines. Two quick asks so we can scope the MAP and procurement:

1) We need your recommended deployment path (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) for the following workloads:
   - Patient-facing summarization (PHI in test data)
   - High-throughput batch embeddings for nightly analytics
   - Low-latency chat for provider portal (SLA: p95 < 400ms)

2) Region constraints: must be US data residency (primary us-east, potential failover us-west).

3) Procurement timeline: if we decide Dedicated, what lead time and contract steps should we expect?

Attaching our security checklist and the procurement contact. Can we get a MAP draft and call next week?

Best,
Alex Bryant
VP Engineering | CoreHealth

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & Deployment Path — CoreHealth evaluation

Hannah / team — following up with concrete lead times and technical tradeoffs for CoreHealth's three workloads. Summary first, details below:

Summary recommendations:
- Hosted: immediate onboarding (hours) for dev / exploratory work. Good for embeddings and early chat testing.
- Dedicated: production candidate. Lead time: 6–8 weeks (capacity reservation + baseline config). Guarantees for throughput and isolation.
- Private (VPC/On-prem): for PHI or strict compliance. Lead time: 10–16 weeks depending on networking and KMS/HSM integration.

Technical notes by workload:
- Patient summarization (PHI): Private if you must keep keys/flow on-prem. Otherwise Dedicated with per-tenant KMS and audit logging is acceptable. We'll enforce redaction guidance in the MAP.
- Batch embeddings: Use hosted with scheduled burst windows for cost efficiency. If nightly volume exceeds ~500k vectors/day, Dedicated pricing becomes materially better.
- Provider chat (low latency): Dedicated with dedicated GPU pool and continuous batching disabled for critical endpoints. Canary in us-east, global fallback to hosted us-west for resilience.

Estimated cost/time bullets:
- Dedicated setup: 6–8 weeks, initial commit (monthly) + provisioning.
- Private setup: 10–16 weeks, networking & security review, onsite validation optional.
- Hosted: immediate; rate-limited by quota until committed capacity requested.

I attached a short brief with these numbers and a sample canary rollout plan.

Attachments: deployment-options-brief.pdf

-Marcus
PM, Infrastructure | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marcus — that helps. CoreHealth preference at this stage: Dedicated for production (throughput + SLA), with Hosted as an automated fallback during capacity or for dev. Private is a blocker for timeline given procurement — we cannot commit to 10–16 weeks for the initial rollout.

Can you confirm the following so I can brief procurement:
- Target go-live (production-serving traffic): earliest date we could realistically hit if we sign Dedicated by 3/25.
- List of items procurement will require (SLA, SOC2 evidence, DPA, PO terms).

We'd like to canary in us-east with a gradual ramp (1% -> 10% -> 50%) over two weeks, then full cutover. Also want the fallback routing to Hosted in us-west for DR.

Procurement attached a short template. Happy to take a 30m cadence to walk the MAP next week.

Alex

Quick internal notes on the MAP draft — two small asks before we send final to CoreHealth:

1) Canary config: recommend starting canary at 0.5% (not 1%) for the patient-facing summarization workload due to PHI sampling risk; auto-roll back on error rate >1.5% for 5m window.
2) Batching/cache profile: for the provider chat, pin quantization profile Q4_8 and reserve continuous KV cache for the Dedicated pool to meet p95 < 400ms. I put a short comment on row 12 of the spreadsheet.

Evelyn — procurement will want SOC2 Type II report + DPA; include sample SLA language (we have a short template). Marcus — can you add an optional accelerated provisioning line (2-week tech path) and the cost delta so CoreHealth knows the tradeoff?

I'll merge comments and send final after Evelyn confirms procurement checklist.

-Rishi
